perv.translation: abbr. perversion 颠倒; 曲解; pervert 反常; perverted 不正当的

pervade.translation: vt. 弥漫于, 遍及于, 流行于, 蔓延, 渗透于, 充满

pervaded.translation: v. 遍及, 弥漫( pervade的过去式和过去分词 )

pervades.translation: v. 遍及, 弥漫( pervade的第三人称单数 )

pervading.translation: v. 遍及, 弥漫( pervade的现在分词 )

pervaporation.definition: n the concentration of a colloidal solution whose colloid will not pass through a semipermeable membrane; solution is placed in a bag of the membrane and the solvent is evaporated off

pervaporization.translation: [化] 渗透蒸发; 膜蒸发

pervasion.definition: n the process of permeating or infusing something with a substance
pervasion.translation: n. 扩散, 渗透, 弥漫, 流行

pervasive.translation: a. 普遍的, 流行的, 到处蔓延的, 到处渗透的

pervasively.translation: adv. 无处不在地, 遍布地

pervasiveness.definition: n. the quality of filling or spreading throughout
pervasiveness.translation: n. 无处不在, 遍布

perverse.definition: s. marked by a disposition to oppose and contradict
perverse.translation:
a. 乖张的, 故意作对的, 有悖常情的, 执迷不悟的, 歪曲的, 错误的, 不正当的
[法] 邪恶的, 罪恶的:堕落的, 不合法的

perversed.translation:
a. 不正当的；邪恶的；堕落的；乖张的；脾气别扭的；故意作对的
n. 【数学、医学】倒错

perversely.definition:
r. deliberately deviant
r. in a contrary disobedient manner

perverseness.definition: n. The quality or state of being perverse.

perversest.definition:
superlative of perverse
s. marked by a disposition to oppose and contradict
perversest.translation:
(perverse 的最高级) a. 乖张的, 故意作对的, 有悖常情的, 执迷不悟的, 歪曲的, 错误的, 不正当的
[法] 邪恶的, 罪恶的:堕落的, 不合法的

perversion.translation:
n. 走入邪路, 败坏, 堕落, 违反常情, 变态, 反常, 误用, 滥用, 歪曲, 颠倒
[医] 倒错, 乖常, 颠倒

perversion of appetite.translation: [医] 异食癖, 食欲倒错

perversions.translation: n. 歪曲( perversion的复数形式 ); 变坏; 变态心理

perversities.definition:
plural of perversity
n. deliberately deviating from what is good
perversities.translation: (perversity 的复数) n. 乖僻, 倔强, 任性, 反常, 性变态

perversity.definition: n. deliberately deviating from what is good
perversity.translation: n. 乖僻, 倔强, 任性, 反常, 性变态

perversive.definition: s tending to corrupt or pervert
perversive.translation: a. 造成堕落的, 造成反常的, 歪曲性的

pervert.definition:
n. a person whose behavior deviates from what is acceptable especially in sexual behavior
v. change the inherent purpose or function of something
pervert.translation:
vt. 使堕落, 使反常, 歪曲, 滥用, 使左右颠倒, 唆使...性变态
n. 堕落者, 行为反常者, 背教者, 性欲反常者

perverted.definition:
v corrupt morally or by intemperance or sensuality
v practice sophistry; change the meaning of or be vague about in order to mislead or deceive
v change the inherent purpose or function of something
s (used of sexual behavior) showing or appealing to bizarre or deviant tastes
s having an intended meaning altered or misrepresented
s deviating from what is considered moral or right or proper or good
perverted.translation: a. 堕落的, 歪曲的, 行为反常的, 性变态的

perverted sensatons.translation: [医] 感觉异常, 感觉倒错

perverter.definition: n. One who perverts (a person or thing).

pervertible.translation: a. 可引入邪路的, 易反常的, 易被滥用的, 易被歪曲的, 易被曲解的

perverting.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Pervert
perverting.translation: v. 滥用( pervert的现在分词 ); 腐蚀; 败坏; 使堕落

perverts.definition:
n a person whose behavior deviates from what is acceptable especially in sexual behavior
v corrupt morally or by intemperance or sensuality
v practice sophistry; change the meaning of or be vague about in order to mislead or deceive
v change the inherent purpose or function of something
perverts.translation:
n. 性变态者( pervert的名词复数 )
v. 滥用( pervert的第三人称单数 ); 腐蚀; 败坏; 使堕落

pervicacious.translation: a. 极固执的,极任性的

pervious.definition: a. admitting of passage or entrance
pervious.translation:
a. 使通过的, 能渗透的, 让过去的, 能接受的, 有穿透力的
[医] 可渗透的, 可透过的

perviousness.definition:
n. The quality or state of being pervious; as, the
   perviousness of glass.

pervo.definition:
A redundantly shortened version of pervet.  See also [pervet] and [perv].
> "Don't be a pervo when my parents are around"
